rationale.edition: The complete changed-files list spans both trees: OSS paths (src/api/common, src/api/management, src/api/search, src/search, src/search_service, web/src/layouts/MainLayout.vue) and enterprise paths under o2_openfga/ (model.fga, model.json, authorizer/authz.rs, meta/mapping.rs, meta/route_permissions.rs). This is the linked OSS+ENT sister pair (the diff body even marks o2-enterprise #2507), so the edition is 'both' — an OSS implementation plus the enterprise OpenFGA authorization layer.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no tests-added label or skip request in the trigger comment (empty), and the change is not docs/CI-only: it alters backend endpoints and a user-facing Vue layout file. It exercises a real user-facing permission/visibility flow, so it must proceed to E2E.
rationale.e2e: The change alters a user-facing flow: the zo_config payload now carries a per-user search_inspector_enabled flag, and MainLayout.vue refetches the full config on org switch so that inspector entry points are shown/hidden per the caller's org and role. Verifying that non-admin/non-granted users do not see the inspector and that org switching refreshes visibility is real UI behavior worth an E2E spec.
rationale.area: The search inspector profiles search queries and is surfaced from the Logs search experience (the /search/profile endpoint is search-oriented); the only frontend file touched is the shared MainLayout. Logs is the closest product area and the natural home for a search-profiling spec.
rationale.group: Logs-Features is the existing matrix shard that already hosts search-related feature specs (e.g. searchPatterns.spec.js in the ENT overlay), so the new searchInspector spec belongs alongside it rather than inventing a new group.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — no files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ were changed. The only tests added are Rust unit tests (test_is_valid_trace_id in search_inspector.rs, test_search_profile_resolves_to_search_inspector_object in route_permissions.rs), which are not Playwright E2E coverage, so they do not set existing_tests_in_diff.
